tasks.brief: Replaces T14. (1) At the cash goal (existing end-of-cycle check), pause and show the choice screen (CHOICE_* from story/screens.md): title, text, two buttons, each with its effect line. No close button. (2) Release: choose the ending with the Release table in story/endings.md (first match, default END_ENOUGH). Corporation: choose with the table T75 adds. Inputs: learned skill ids, learned count per branch, dominant branch, cycle goal reached, final cash, last-cycle flag. (3) Ending screen: name, text, END_STAT_LINE (cycle and cash), buttons END_BTN_NEW, END_BTN_MENU, END_BTN_QUIT. (4) Window ends without goal: END_LOSS and END_LOSS_STAT with cash and goal, same buttons. (5) Dead-state rescue stays a notice (NOT_DEAD_RESCUE), not an ending. (6) Once answered, call the recorder with the side and ending id; do not write files here (T78). Texts come from story_text.gd (T76). Handoff: handoffs/gameplay-programmer/<date>-T77.json.

tasks.title: Choice and outcome recording to user:// (local only), force-goal debug control
tasks.brief: (1) On each answered win, record once into user://stats.json: schema_version 1, wins, choices {release, corporation}, endings {id: count}. Record when the choice is answered, not when the screen opens. Each run carries a recorded flag saved with the run, so a reload never counts it twice. Do not record losses (owner OQ3 may change this). (2) Write atomically: user://stats.json.tmp, then rename. Missing file: create it. Unreadable file: move it to user://stats.bad.json and start fresh. (3) No network, no analytics SDK, no name or id. Nothing leaves the machine. (4) No in-game stats screen (owner decides). (5) Debug-only (stripped from release export, like debug_menu): a force-goal control that sets cash to win_cash at the end of the current cycle, so QA can reach both branches now. Normal play does not reach 9000 in system 1 (T10: 7120 at cycle 30; T54 on hold). Show the stats file path in the debug menu. Handoff: handoffs/gameplay-programmer/<date>-T78.json.
